preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
The number of SWAG Traits n in each test case must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ki <= 100 for ki in sizes)
preconditions.description: The size of each SWAG Trait ki must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 1000 for x in elements)
preconditions.description: Each element in the SWAG Traits must be a positive integer less than or equal to 1000.

postconditions.description: The output must be two space-separated integers representing the Swag Levels of RK and RG.
The sum of RK's and RG's Swag Levels must equal the total sum of all integers in the SWAG Traits.
